title: Sheinbaum Begins Her Return to Mexico After Participating in APEC to Lead the Mexican Revolution Parade
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by[La Jornada Editorial
Staff](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [November 19, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/19/politica/sheinbaum-
espera-en-shenzen-china-el-vuelo-de-regreso-a-mexico-para-encabezar-desfile-
de-la-revolucion-mexicana), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** Governance Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez reported at the
start of the morning press conference that President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo
is at the airport in Shenzhen, China, to take a commercial flight back to
Mexico City after her participation in the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation
summit.

The president is expected to arrive in the country’s capital **early tomorrow,
Friday** , and will later lead the civilian and military parade marking the
**116th anniversary of the start of the Mexican Revolution**.

Rodríguez said APEC “represents an opportunity to strengthen Mexico’s presence
in that region,” noting that the 21 participating countries together account
for around **60 percent of gross domestic product**. For that reason, she
said, “the agreements and dialogues have important implications for trade and
global development.”

She highlighted that President Sheinbaum held several bilateral meetings, and
“we know this gathering will make it possible to strengthen trade relations,
promote investment, exchange experiences in innovation and technology, and
foster effective cooperation.”

We are awaiting her arrival in Mexico, she said.
